################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the waic results of the experiments 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$outputs <- "../outputs/perpathogen"
dirs$tables <- "../outputs/modres_waic"

pat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
           "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
           "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",
           "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")
```

# Function to obtain waic df
```{r}
fun_waic_df <- function(pathogen = "rota") {
  
  file_path <- glue("{dirs$tables}/{pathogen}_tbl_waic_models.rds")
  
  # Create file if it does not exist 
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    # Create the file
    waic_l <- data.frame()
    saveRDS(waic_l, file_path)
    cat("File created:", file_path)
  } else {
    waic_l <- readRDS(file_path)
    cat("File already exists:", file_path)
  }
  
  mod_files_l <- str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}")), "rds"), 
                            "bmv")
  mod_miss_l <- setdiff(mod_files_l, waic_l$mod)
  
  waic_miss_l <- sapply(mod_miss_l, function(miss) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/{miss}"))$criteria$waic$waic 
  }, simplify = F)
  
  if(length(waic_miss_l) > 0) {
    waic_miss_l <- bind_rows(waic_miss_l) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "mod", values_to = "waic")
  }
  
  waic_l <- bind_rows(waic_miss_l, waic_l) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(-waic) %>%
    mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) 
  
  saveRDS(waic_l, file_path)
  return(waic_l)
}
```

# Extracting WAIC 
```{r}
# List of pathogens and extract waic
lapply(pat_l, fun_waic_df)

# One pathogen example 
fun_waic_df("rota") %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod, "csni", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])

# All pathogens comparison 
all_waic <- sapply(pat_l, function(x) {
  fun_waic_df(x) %>%
    filter(str_detect(mod, "csni", negate = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(waic) %>%
    mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])
}, simplify = FALSE)

bind_rows(all_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(rn = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rn == 1)
```

# Sanity check:  Checking if the models converged 
```{r}
df_rhats_cs <- readRDS("../outputs/modres_rhats/df_rhats_cs.rds")

bind_rows(all_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  left_join(df_rhats_cs) %>%
  filter(Rhat == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(mod = str_replace(mod, "multi_", "multi"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "reg_", "reg"),
         mod = str_remove_all(mod, ".rds|_gauss|-"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "csi_", "csi")) %>%
  separate(mod, into = c("vac", "s", "pathogen", "mod")) %>%
  select(-s) %>%
  mutate(vac = str_remove(vac, "bm")) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = c(
    "rota", "vzv",
    "multimmr", "multimmrvzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel",
    "multidtp", "multidtpa", "multidtpw", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "multipertu", "pertu",
    "hav", "hbv", "hib",
    "multimen", "multihibmen", "men",
    "multistrep", "strep",
    "multipolio", "polio", "multiipv", "ipv", "multiopv", "opv"))) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = pathogen, color = mod)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  scale_x_sqrt(breaks = c(0,1,10,20,40,60,80)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), linetype = "dotted") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "pink","pink", "red", "darkred"))
  #facet_wrap(pathogen~.)
```
